jobs.description:
In dieser spannenden Rolle stellst du den stabilen Betrieb unserer Infrastruktur sicher, leitest technische Teilprojekte und arbeitest aktiv an modernen Lösungen rund um CARI, dem führenden ERP für Strassenverkehrs und Schifffahrtsämter in der Schweiz. Du unterstützt unsere Kunden bei der Einführung neuer Technologien und trägst damit direkt zum digitalen Fortschritt der öffentlichen Hand im Mobilitätsbereich bei. Wenn du Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest, technisch breit aufgestellt bist und ein Umfeld mit Startup Kultur und Teamgeist schätzt, passt du perfekt zu uns.
Deine Rolle
• Sicherstellen einer stets verfügbaren und reibungslos funktionierenden internen Infrastruktur.
• Implementieren von Lösungen und Installationen direkt bei unseren Kunden.
• Erarbeiten von Betriebskonzepten für CARI Lösungen sowie Erstellen der technischen Dokumentation.
• Leiten von Infrastruktur und technischen Teilprojekten.
• Bereitstellen und Weiterentwickeln von Entwicklungsinfrastrukturen (CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Atlassian JIRA / Bitbucket / Bamboo, Kanban).
• Einbringen von Expertise zur Prävention und effizienten Lösung technischer Probleme.
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Kundenservice, den Entwicklungsteams und den Betriebsverantwortlichen unserer Lösungen.
Dein Profil
• Abgeschlossene Lehre oder höhere Berufsausbildung im Bereich Informatik.
• Fundierte Kenntnisse in UNIX- und Windows Systemen.
• Erfahrung im Umgang mit ORACLE Datenbanken.
• Gute Kenntnisse in Netzwerken, Firewall, VPN, Sicherheit.
• Mehrjährige Projekterfahrung sowie Berufserfahrung als System Engineer oder Technical Account Manager.
• Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und Freude im Umgang mit Kunden.
• Fliessend in Deutsch; technisches Englisch, Französisch von Vorteil.
• Hohe Flexibilität und Bereitschaft zu regelmässigen Dienstreisen an den Standort Morges sowie zu Kundenterminen in der ganzen Schweiz.
Deine Benefits
• Bis zu 60 % Home-Office bei einem 100 %-Pensum möglich
• Ferienkauf (2 Wochen pro Jahr)
• 41h Woche mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten bei einem Vollzeitpensum
• Mind. 25 Tage Ferien pro Jahr

• Conoscenza approfondita dei sistemi UNIX e Windows.
• Esperienza nel trattare con i database ORACLE.
• Buona conoscenza delle reti, firewall, VPN, sicurezza.
• Diversi anni di esperienza di progetto e di esperienza professionale come ingegnere di sistema o responsabile di account tecnico.
• Forte orientamento del cliente e gioia nel trattare con i clienti.

descriptionByLocale.en:
In this exciting role, you ensure the stable operation of our infrastructure, lead technical sub-projects and actively work on modern solutions around CARI, the leading ERP for road transport and shipping offices in Switzerland. You support our customers with the introduction of new technologies and thus directly contribute to the digital progress of the public sector in the mobility sector. If you want to take on responsibility, are technically broad and appreciate an environment with startup culture and team spirit, you are a perfect fit for us.
Your role
• Ensure an always available and smoothly functioning internal infrastructure.
• Implement solutions and installations directly with our customers.
• Development of operational concepts for CARI solutions and preparation of technical documentation.
• Management of infrastructure and technical sub-projects.
• Provision and development of development infrastructures (CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Atlassian JIRA / Bitbucket / Bamboo, Kanban).
• Providing expertise for the prevention and efficient solution of technical problems.
• Close cooperation with customer service, development teams and the operational managers of our solutions.
Your profile
• Completed apprenticeship or higher vocational training in computer science.
• In-depth knowledge of UNIX and Windows systems.
• Experience in dealing with ORACLE databases.
• Good knowledge of networks, firewall, VPN, security.
• Several years of project experience and professional experience as a system engineer or technical account manager.
• Strong customer orientation and joy in dealing with customers.
• Flowing in German; technical English, French beneficial.
• High flexibility and readiness for regular business trips to the Morges location as well as customer appointments throughout Switzerland.
Your Benefits
• Up to 60% home office possible with a 100% pension
• Holiday purchase (2 weeks per year)
• 41h week with flexible working hours on a full-time workload
• Mind. 25 days of holidays per year
• Support for 100% financial or temporal training
• Free SBB half-ax subscription for all employees
We maintain an open you culture – so feel free to send us your application directly in the you form.

Digitization is your passion! Are you a doer who actively participates and promotes modern software architecture? Then you've come to the right place! Support us actively in defining and implementing planned technical projects.
We are a motivated and dynamic team of product and project managers and are looking for YOU as a technical solution link to our development teams.
Your Role
• Co-responsibility for the solution architecture of our complete software solution TAXA for Swiss tax authorities and central role in pre-sales by defining and representing the technical solution design at the customer's site
• Presentation of the solution and integration into existing IT landscapes as well as representation of the tax department in internal architecture committees
• Leading solution design and coordinating technology and development partners in innovation projects (proof-of-concepts)
• Responsible for the architecture part of tenders of the cantonal and municipal tax offices
Your profile
• At least five years of experience as a solution architect or technical lead in agile software development of complex software solutions with in-depth customer contact (presales, project presentations), ideally also in the public sector
• Confident appearance in customer meetings, presentation skills at level C and the ability to translate technical arguments into sales arguments
• Team player with an open, communicative personality, who likes to work out solutions in small teams and represent them both internally and externally
• Analytical, quick to understand, structured and solution-oriented with a high level of assertiveness and perseverance
• Very good knowledge of German and English as well as a degree in computer science or equivalent professional experience
• In-depth knowledge in the areas of microservice and microfrontend-oriented architecture, SaaS, Kubernetes, containers and related activation systems, as well as experience in dealing with the technologies Java, Quarkus, Kafka, Maven, Hibernate, Liquibase and PostgreSQL; IAM knowledge (OAuth 2.0 and OpenID) is an advantage
Your benefits
• Up to 60% home office possible with a 100% workload
• Holiday purchase (2 weeks per year)
• 41-hour week with flexible working hours with a full-time workload
• At least 25 days of vacation per year
• 100% funding for further training in terms of funding or time
• Free SBB Half-Fare travelcard for all employees
We cultivate an open informal culture – so feel free to send us your application directly in the informal form.

jobs.title: Software Engineer – Data Migration 80 - 100%
jobs.description:
Wir sind ein motiviertes Software-Engineering-Team und suchen dich für die Weiterentwicklung unser Data Migration Services, damit wir neue Kunden an unser neuen Steuerlösungen anbinden können. Du unterstützt unser Team bei der Umsetzung technischer Vorhaben und arbeitest eng mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen. Bei uns arbeitest du mit modernen Technologien, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Raum für eigene Ideen.
Deine Rolle
• Du gestaltest, optimierst und skalierst unsere Migrationsstrecken
